name: Testing

      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          submodules: false
      - name: Set up PDM
        uses: pdm-project/setup-pdm@94a823180e06fcde4ad29308721954a521c96ed0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Cache PDM dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pdm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pdm-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}-${{ hashFiles('pdm.lock') }}-3.12
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pdm-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}-${{ hashFiles('pdm.lock') }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-pdm-
      - name: Install requirements
        run: pdm update && pdm sync -d -G testing
      - name: Run code analysis (package)
        run: pdm run -v mypy ./exegol/ --ignore-missing-imports --check-untyped-defs --pretty # TODO add --disallow-untyped-defs
      - name: Run code analysis (source)
        run: pdm run -v mypy ./exegol.py --ignore-missing-imports --check-untyped-defs --pretty # TODO add --disallow-untyped-defs
      - name: Find spawn.sh script version

      - name: Pre-commit checks
        run: pdm run -v pre-commit run --all-files --hook-stage pre-commit

    name: Compatibility checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: testing
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]
        os: [win32, linux, darwin]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          submodules: false
      - name: Set up PDM
        uses: pdm-project/setup-pdm@94a823180e06fcde4ad29308721954a521c96ed0
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.version }}
      - name: Cache PDM dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pdm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pdm-${{ matrix.version }}-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}-${{ hashFiles('pdm.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pdm-${{ matrix.version }}-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}-${{ hashFiles('pdm.lock') }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-pdm-${{ matrix.version }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-pdm-
      - name: Install requirements
        run: pdm update && pdm sync -d -G testing
      - name: Check python compatibility for ${{ matrix.os }}/${{ matrix.version }}
        run: pdm run -v mypy ./exegol.py --ignore-missing-imports --check-untyped-defs --python-version ${{ matrix.version }} --platform ${{ matrix.os }}

  build-n-install:
    name: Build and install Python 🐍 package 📦
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: testing
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          submodules: true
      - name: Set up PDM
        uses: pdm-project/setup-pdm@94a823180e06fcde4ad29308721954a521c96ed0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Cache PDM dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pdm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pdm-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}-${{ hashFiles('pdm.lock') }}-3.12
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pdm-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}-${{ hashFiles('pdm.lock') }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-pdm-
      - name: Build Exegol
        run: pdm build
      - name: Create testing venv
        run: pdm venv create -n vtest-source --with-pip && pdm venv create -n vtest-wheel --with-pip
      - name: Install pip source package
        run: pdm run --venv vtest-source -v pip install ./dist/*.tar.gz
      - name: Install pip source package
        run: pdm run --venv vtest-wheel -v pip install ./dist/*.tar.gz",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly fetches/installs PDM dependencies (pdm update && pdm sync) in the testing job, every cell of the 15-cell compatibility matrix, and the build-n-install job, with no dependency cache present. This matches the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency_cache pattern: repeated dependency fetching is measurable, and cache inputs can include the lockfile/environment (pyproject.toml, pdm.lock, Python version, runner OS). Adding actions/cache@v4 for the PDM cache directory (~/.cache/pdm) before each install step preserves all existing checks and coverage while reducing repeated dependency download time. No contraindications apply: there is no equivalent cache already, and the cached content is dependency wheels rather than mutable/untrusted build outputs. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or privileged actions are added, and no new network access beyond the existing PyPI dependency installation is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
